two == 01:30 -- en.wiktionary.org glosses that very phrase "half past one".

marker_future: შემდეგ is წინ's antonym and its mirror in every respect: a postposition
governing the genitive, so "სამი თვის შემდეგ" is three months from now.
marker_last: The antonym of მომავალი, likewise prenominal: "გასული წელი" == last year.
marker_next: An adjective standing BEFORE its noun -- Georgian is postpositional in its
adposition system, not in its modifiers.  The dative/adverbial form მომავალ
is the one a case-marked noun takes: "მომავალ წელს" == next year.
en.wiktionary.org, მომავალი, sense "next" with that example --

marker_this: The proximal demonstrative, prenominal: "ეს თვე" == this month.

locale ships no week duration unit, because the two senses share one
declension and no source disambiguates them.  The count therefore vetoes
the weekday reading: answering "Sunday" to "two weeks" would give a caller

Georgian, and the postpositions წინ ("ago") and შემდეგ ("after")
govern the genitive -- "სამი თვის წინ" is three months ago.
